name: Mom's Day Off!
source:
You find yourself at the entrance of a beautiful fantasy garden. Take your time wandering through, stay as long as you want and discover the magic that lies within!

[From [url=https://ragequitthisish.itch.io/moms-day-off]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你来到了一座美丽的奇幻花园入口。悠闲地漫步其中，想待多久就待多久，去发现藏在花园里的魔法吧！

[摘自[url=https://ragequitthisish.itch.io/moms-day-off]itch.io[/url]]
